answer_1.quote: We pretrain all models on the C4 dataset ... Following popular and state-of-the-art Transformer-based encoder-decoder MoE models, we use T5.1.1 as the backbone of our MoWE models.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers to questions in closed-book QA settings, which is a form of natural language generation.
